consequence.statement: The ValidateCAA feature gate still functions in cert-manager v1.17 but is deprecated and will be removed entirely in cert-manager v1.18.0, so environments relying on it for CAA DNS record validation during ACME issuance will lose that behaviour when they upgrade to v1.18.0.
consequence.remediation: Remove ValidateCAA from feature-gate configuration (--feature-gates / chart featureGates) and stop relying on CAA record validation during ACME issuance before upgrading to cert-manager v1.18.0.

original.statement: cert-manager v1.17 deprecates the ValidateCAA feature gate, which validates the CAA DNS record during ACME issuance; it still works in v1.17 but will be removed entirely in cert-manager v1.18.0.

decision.reason: [ev-0d3b308e9192] says the ValidateCAA feature gate is deprecated in v1.17 and "will be removed entirely in cert-manager v1.18.0". [ev-09a9c9047035] repeats this and only says that stopping manual use is "advisable". Neither says anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured in v1.17, so kind deprecation (review class) with low severity is what the evidence supports. The remediation matches the upgrade guide's advice. Caveat: this section also covers other changes (NameConstraints and UseDomainQualifiedFinalizer turned on by default, and the new CAInjectorMerging gate). This consequence is right only for the ValidateCAA subject that is fixed in the context.
